messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: integer lattice with optimized shear

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Within the integer lattice with optimized shear direction, the configuration of 13 points S = {(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,1),(3,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,2),(3,2),(1,3)} mapped affinely to [0,1]×[0,1] via (x,y) ↦ (x/3, (y + x·t)/3) achieves a minimum triangle area of (1 − |t|)/18 for any shear parameter |t| < 1, and the optimal choice t* = 0 yields a minimum triangle area of 1/18. This is optimal among all sheared lattice configurations because the three collinear lattice points on each horizontal row force any triangle with two points in one row to have height at least 1/3, and triangles with all three points in two adjacent rows achieve area exactly 1/18 when t = 0."}
